guide_subtitle: Follow these steps to enable AI dialogue features:
guide_step_0_p1: 1. Log in to the QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com)
guide_step_0_p2: 2. Create a bot app and get AppID and ClientSecret
guide_step_1_desc: Search for your bot in QQ and add it to start a private chat.
guide_step_2_desc: Add the bot to a group and mention @Bot to trigger dialogue.
guide_step_3_desc: Add the bot to a guild and ensure it has the appropriate message permissions.
